explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain precisely why the objective increases from 135000.0 to 137800.0 by tracing the added risky-leasing logic from the business brief’s “gate” language through the code and data: identify the exact new variables (`r[name]`, `y[name]`, `s[name]`), the revised objective construction (`objective_terms` and `risk_coeff`), and the CSV fields/values that make `Property_2` the only property with positive risky allocation in the optimal integer solution. Then use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to name at least two binding revised constraints and their dual values/slacks, interpret their business meaning, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate those shadow prices to claim the family would gain the same marginal value from increasing `total_risky_budget` or relaxing the risky gate further in the integer model.
